description:
Reads one bounded metadata-selected object page.
Use when: explicit world-map/async-PvP object access after reading horizon://docs/shared-objects.
Not for: background polling, automatic page traversal, interpreting opaque bytes or using this as a combat validator.
Requires: userId and the player's session: sign in with horizon_signin_email or horizon_signin_anonymous and pass its accessToken as sessionToken.
Side effects: Read only POST. At most 256 candidates, 50 objects and 1 MiB decoded bytes. Empty page with cursor is valid. Random is nonuniform, at most two indexed ranges.
Returns: {objects,nextCursor,pollAfterSeconds,serverTime}; explicit next-cursor may proceed immediately, refresh honors interval.
Errors: 409 revision/state/permission conflict or lost response: explicitly reread owned objects/usage and reconcile original intent, never automatically retry with newer revisions or a replacement ID. 404 does not distinguish missing/private/expired data. 422 retains existing data on quota/archive failure. 401 means the session is missing or expired: sign in again and retry with the new accessToken. 403 for a session means the token belongs to another user: pass the userId that signed in. Needs HORIZON_API_KEY. Every failure returns an error result (isError) with the HTTP status and body: a 401 that horizon_test_connection also returns means HORIZON_API_KEY is wrong, 429 means the account's per-minute rate limit was reached (wait a minute, then retry).

collection.description: Permanent collection or configured field key, lowercase ASCII

query.description: Explicit bounded query and original cursor; one permission partition only

field.description: Permanent collection or configured field key, lowercase ASCII

sessionToken.description: Player accessToken, sent only as Bearer

userId.description: Active player UUID matching the authenticated session and project
